sections.title: Questions.
sections.lead: Straight answers on how Octillion measures agent preference, what it does and doesn’t touch, which agents it covers, and how your team gets started during early access.

items.question: What is APO?
items.answer: Agentic Preference Optimization: measuring and improving how often AI coding agents choose your product while they do real work.

items.question: How is it different from SEO or GEO?
items.answer: SEO is for people reading search results, GEO for chatbots answering questions. APO is for agents writing code, where the outcome is an install, not a link.

items.question: Which coding agents do you test?
items.answer: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Cline and more, mixed in proportion to how developers actually use them.

items.question: Do the agents know about my product?
items.answer: No. They get blind, realistic tasks in real repos. Your product is used only to score the transcript afterwards.

items.question: Does Octillion change the models?
items.answer: No. No paid placement, no prompt injection. You improve docs, examples and SDKs; Octillion measures whether preference moved.

items.question: What counts as a pick?
items.answer: Adopted means the agent installed, imported or configured you. Recommended means it explicitly advised you. Mentioned and Competitor are tracked separately, never counted as picks.

items.question: Can I check a verdict myself?
items.answer: Yes. Every verdict links to the transcript lines behind it: the install command, the import or the sentence that earned it.

items.question: Can I bring my own tasks and repos?
items.answer: Yes. Tasks should mirror what your buyers really ask agents to do. We help you shape a starting set during onboarding.

items.question: Where do I see results?
items.answer: In your Octillion dashboard, or by asking in Claude or ChatGPT through the Octillion connector, with charts rendered in the chat.

items.question: Can my whole team use it?
items.answer: Yes. Invite teammates, set roles, and split your usage budget across teams and people from the billing page.

items.question: How are transcripts stored?
items.answer: Each transcript is kept with its verdict and scoped to your organization’s account. Tell us during onboarding if you have retention requirements.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: We’re in early access. Pricing depends on scenarios, models and runs. Request early access and talk to us.
